FIELDS.NAME: Evergreen Community Bank
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Compliance Officer, Evergreen Community Bank, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@evergreencb.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Evergreen Community Bank operates as a community-focused financial institution providing a wide range of banking services, including personal and business checking and savings accounts, loans, mortgages, and financial advisory services. Our operations emphasize adherence to regulatory requirements and maintaining a strong risk management framework. We have established robust internal controls and regular employee training programs to ensure compliance with financial regulations and security protocols. With secure, monitored vaults and restricted access to sensitive areas, our facilities are designed to safeguard clients' assets and information. Additionally, we actively engage in community outreach initiatives to promote financial literacy and support local small businesses. Our commitment to ethical practices and transparency mitigates risks associated with unresolved legal issues.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: "On 03/15/2023, a customer reported unauthorized transactions resulting from a phishing incident, resulting in a loss of $2,500. The loss was promptly reported, and all affected accounts were secured. The incident is currently under investigation, and we are working closely with law enforcement to identify the perpetrators and prevent future occurrences."
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Secure Class 1, UL-rated vault with electronic access control and 24/7 monitoring.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure fencing around the premises with 24/7 monitored surveillance and regular security patrols.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Evergreen Community Bank has no past, present, or discontinued operations that involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. The institution focuses primarily on providing financial services without exposure to hazardous operations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Evergreen Community Bank does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its operations. The focus of the institution is primarily on providing financial services to the community.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The compliance officer, John Smith, checks certificates to ensure all necessary documentation is in place.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Evergreen Community Bank has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crimes. The institution maintains a strong commitment to ethical practices and regulatory compliance.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Evergreen Community Bank has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years, maintaining a strong history of compliance and risk management.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Evergreen Community Bank does not lease employees to or from other employers, focusing solely on its own staff to maintain internal operations and compliance.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Evergreen Community Bank carries Workers Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with statutory requirements and to protect its employees. This coverage is essential for maintaining a safe workplace and managing potential employee-related risks.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Evergreen Community Bank does not own or operate any other business. The institution focuses exclusively on providing a range of banking services to the community.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Evergreen Community Bank currently does not have any other insurance policies with the same company. The sole policy is for the year 2024, and no additional policies are listed.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Evergreen Community Bank is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. The institution focuses exclusively on providing financial services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Evergreen Community Bank does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations are solely focused on providing banking and financial services to the community.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Evergreen Community Bank has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, maintaining a solid financial standing.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Evergreen Community Bank does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as it solely focuses on providing banking and financial services, ensuring a safe operational environment.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Evergreen Community Bank does not have any exposure to catastrophes, as its operations focus solely on providing financial services without involvement in high-risk activities. The institution emphasizes risk management and compliance with regulatory requirements.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Evergreen Community Bank has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring, maintaining a commitment to compliance and ethical practices.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Evergreen Community Bank currently does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring a safe environment for both staff and clients. The institution maintains compliance with all applicable fire safety regulations.
